report.incidentSummary: On 2026-09-23 starting around 09:30 IST (04:00 UTC), users reported that mutual fund holdings and P&L values on the portfolio screen had not updated since the previous day. Stock holdings and valuations were unaffected. Investigation revealed that the scheduled overnight mutual fund NAV import job (nav-import) did not execute in job-scheduler, leaving market-data-service with stale NAV data dated 2026-09-21. As a result, portfolio-service detected fund NAVs older than one trading day and displayed the last available NAVs.
report.rootCauseStatement: The scheduled daily NAV import job (nav-import) failed to trigger in job-scheduler overnight on 2026-09-22, preventing market-data-service from ingesting updated AMFI NAVs for 2026-09-22. Consequently, NAV age exceeded 35 hours and portfolio-service fell back to displaying previous-day NAVs (dated 2026-09-21).

hypotheses.cause: The scheduled nav-import job failed to run overnight in job-scheduler, preventing AMFI mutual fund NAV ingestion and causing market-data-service to serve stale NAVs from 2026-09-21.
hypotheses.rationale: market-data-service NAV age increased monotonically from ~26.4 hours at 2026-09-22T20:30Z to ~35.4 hours at 2026-09-23T05:30Z without any refresh. Scheduler logs show other batch jobs running but nav-import completely absent. Market-data-service served 2026-09-21 NAVs, prompting portfolio-service warnings and fallback to last available NAV.

hypotheses.cause: Configuration change CHG-48221 to cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00Z increased nav keyspace TTL from 1 hour to 6 hours, pinning stale NAV data.
hypotheses.rationale: While CHG-48221 modified nav TTL at 03:25 UTC (08:55 IST), market-data-service's nav_age_s was already climbing since 20:30 UTC the previous day (nav_age_s starting at 95,040 seconds). Upstream market-data-service itself lacked fresh NAVs, ruling out cache TTL as the root cause.

facts.statement: portfolio-service valuation_errors remained at baseline throughout the window (mean 1.08 count/min, max 2.6 count/min).
portfolio-service price_age_s remained low and stable between 1.36s and 2.47s (mean 2.05s).
cache hit rate for the nav keyspace was stable at ~95.5% (93.16% to 97.06%).
portfolio-service emitted 97 WARN logs stating 'fund NAV older than # trading day for # holdings (nav_date=#-#-#); showing last available NAV'.
market-data-service nav_age_s rose monotonically from 95,040s (~26.4h) at 2026-09-22T20:30Z to 127,260s (~35.4h) at 2026-09-23T05:30Z without any reset.
market-data-service logs show NAV queries served data dated 2026-09-21.
job-scheduler executed reconciliation, sip-debit-batch, and payout-batch-am ok, but did not execute nav-import between 2026-09-22T20:30Z and 2026-09-23T05:30Z.
Configuration change CHG-48221 increased cache nav keyspace TTL from 3600s to 21600s at 2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z.

inferences.statement: portfolio-service and cache functioned normally, but portfolio-service intentionally fell back to previous-day valuations because upstream market-data-service supplied NAVs that were out of date.
The daily AMFI NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) on 2026-09-22 never triggered or executed, leading to stale NAVs across market-data-service and portfolio-service.

assumptions.statement: AMFI published daily mutual fund NAV files normally for trading day 2026-09-22.
nav-import was configured on a recurring schedule to trigger via job-scheduler at 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC).

timeline.event: Scheduled nav-import job failed to trigger or run in job-scheduler.
market-data-service nav_age_s was already elevated at 95,040 seconds (~26.4 hours), serving 2026-09-21 NAVs.
CHG-48221 applied to cache service, extending nav TTL from 1h to 6h.
Users began reporting unchanged mutual fund portfolio valuations; portfolio-service logged repeated warnings of NAVs older than one trading day.

confidence.rationale: High confidence based on unambiguous metrics showing market-data-service nav_age_s monotonically increasing over 35 hours, logs confirming served NAVs dated 2026-09-21, and the total absence of nav-import executions in job-scheduler.

gaps.description: Job-scheduler logs and schedule definitions prior to 2026-09-22T20:30:00Z were not inspected due to tool call budget limits.
gaps.impact: The exact mechanism by which nav-import failed to trigger at 23:30 IST (crontab misconfiguration, unscheduled job, or scheduler daemon restart) cannot be pinpointed.

recommendedActions.action: Manually trigger the nav-import job to pull the latest NAV feed from AMFI into market-data-service.
recommendedActions.rationale: Directly refreshes the stale mutual fund NAV dataset from 2026-09-21 to the latest available AMFI data.
recommendedActions.verification: Check market-data-service metric nav_age_s to confirm it drops to near zero, and verify log outputs show successful ingestion of 2026-09-22 NAVs.

recommendedActions.action: Flush the nav keyspace in cache and verify portfolio-service valuation updates.
recommendedActions.rationale: Ensures any stale 2026-09-21 NAVs cached under the 6-hour TTL configured in CHG-48221 are evicted immediately.
recommendedActions.verification: Query portfolio-service logs to confirm cessation of 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day' warnings.

recommendedActions.action: Investigate job-scheduler crontab and scheduler definitions for nav-import, and add alerting for nav_age_s > 86400s.
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents future silent failures of overnight NAV ingestion from going unnoticed until user reports arrive the next morning.
recommendedActions.verification: Confirm job-scheduler cron entry is registered and verify alert fires when synthetic NAV age exceeds threshold.

report.justification: The root cause is definitively established by telemetry: market-data-service nav_age_s had already climbed past 26.4 hours at 2026-09-22T20:30Z (predating the morning cache config change), job-scheduler logs confirmed nav-import never executed during the window, market-data-service served 2026-09-21 NAVs, and portfolio-service logged explicit fallback warnings for NAVs older than one trading day.

findings.summary: Recent changes check identified config change CHG-48221 completed on cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z (08:55 IST), which increased ttl.nav from 3600s to 21600s (6 hours). No other code or config changes occurred across portfolio-service, market-data-service, or job-scheduler. A highly relevant past incident, PIR-2005, showed identical symptoms caused by nav keyspace TTL misconfiguration, resolved by reverting the TTL and flushing the keyspace.

observations.statement: A configuration change (CHG-48221) was applied to the cache service at 2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z (08:55 IST) by v.rao, increasing 'ttl.nav' from 3600 seconds (1 hour) to 21600 seconds (6 hours).
There were no deployments or other configuration changes for portfolio-service, market-data-service, or job-scheduler between 2026-09-22T12:00:00.000Z and 2026-09-23T05:30:00.000Z.

Past incident PIR-2005 (2026-08-27) had identical symptoms ('Fund values on portfolio lagged NAV updates by several hours') caused by nav keyspace cache TTL misconfiguration, and was resolved by reverting the TTL and flushing the nav keyspace.

portfolio-service depends synchronously on market-data-service (timeout 500ms) and cache (timeout 50ms); market-data-service depends on cache (timeout 50ms) and external amfi-nav-feed triggered by job-scheduler at 23:30 IST.

The timing of CHG-48221 at 03:25 UTC (08:55 IST), roughly 35 minutes before user tickets began appearing at ~04:00 UTC (09:30 IST), combined with past incident PIR-2005, strongly points to the nav TTL increase or cached stale NAV values as the primary cause or aggravating factor for stale fund values.

# Investigation report: Mutual fund values not updating

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.85 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-09-23 starting around 09:30 IST (04:00 UTC), users reported that mutual fund holdings and P&L values on the portfolio screen had not updated since the previous day. Stock holdings and valuations were unaffected. Investigation revealed that the scheduled overnight mutual fund NAV import job (nav-import) did not execute in job-scheduler, leaving market-data-service with stale NAV data dated 2026-09-21. As a result, portfolio-service detected fund NAVs older than one trading day and displayed the last available NAVs.

**Root cause:** The scheduled daily NAV import job (nav-import) failed to trigger in job-scheduler overnight on 2026-09-22, preventing market-data-service from ingesting updated AMFI NAVs for 2026-09-22. Consequently, NAV age exceeded 35 hours and portfolio-service fell back to displaying previous-day NAVs (dated 2026-09-21).

## Hypotheses
1. **The scheduled nav-import job failed to run overnight in job-scheduler, preventing AMFI mutual fund NAV ingestion and causing market-data-service to serve stale NAVs from 2026-09-21.** — `job-scheduler`, data_pipeline_failure, confidence 0.85, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_4, ev_6, ev_14, ev_15, ev_16] · Contradicting: none
   - market-data-service NAV age increased monotonically from ~26.4 hours at 2026-09-22T20:30Z to ~35.4 hours at 2026-09-23T05:30Z without any refresh. Scheduler logs show other batch jobs running but nav-import completely absent. Market-data-service served 2026-09-21 NAVs, prompting portfolio-service warnings and fallback to last available NAV.
2. **Configuration change CHG-48221 to cache at 2026-09-23T03:25:00Z increased nav keyspace TTL from 1 hour to 6 hours, pinning stale NAV data.** — `cache`, config_change, confidence 0.15, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_7] · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_14, ev_16]
   - While CHG-48221 modified nav TTL at 03:25 UTC (08:55 IST), market-data-service's nav_age_s was already climbing since 20:30 UTC the previous day (nav_age_s starting at 95,040 seconds). Upstream market-data-service itself lacked fresh NAVs, ruling out cache TTL as the root cause.

## Facts
- portfolio-service valuation_errors remained at baseline throughout the window (mean 1.08 count/min, max 2.6 count/min). [ev_1]
- portfolio-service price_age_s remained low and stable between 1.36s and 2.47s (mean 2.05s). [ev_5]
- cache hit rate for the nav keyspace was stable at ~95.5% (93.16% to 97.06%). [ev_8]
- portfolio-service emitted 97 WARN logs stating 'fund NAV older than # trading day for # holdings (nav_date=#-#-#); showing last available NAV'. [ev_14]
- market-data-service nav_age_s rose monotonically from 95,040s (~26.4h) at 2026-09-22T20:30Z to 127,260s (~35.4h) at 2026-09-23T05:30Z without any reset. [ev_4]
- market-data-service logs show NAV queries served data dated 2026-09-21. [ev_16]
- job-scheduler executed reconciliation, sip-debit-batch, and payout-batch-am ok, but did not execute nav-import between 2026-09-22T20:30Z and 2026-09-23T05:30Z. [ev_15, ev_18]
- Configuration change CHG-48221 increased cache nav keyspace TTL from 3600s to 21600s at 2026-09-23T03:25:00.000Z. [ev_3, ev_7]

## Inferences
- portfolio-service and cache functioned normally, but portfolio-service intentionally fell back to previous-day valuations because upstream market-data-service supplied NAVs that were out of date. [ev_1, ev_5, ev_8, ev_14]
- The daily AMFI NAV import scheduled for 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC) on 2026-09-22 never triggered or executed, leading to stale NAVs across market-data-service and portfolio-service. [ev_4, ev_6, ev_15, ev_16]

## Assumptions
- AMFI published daily mutual fund NAV files normally for trading day 2026-09-22.
- nav-import was configured on a recurring schedule to trigger via job-scheduler at 23:30 IST (18:00 UTC).

## Timeline
- **2026-09-22 23:30 IST (2026-09-22T18:00:00Z)** Scheduled nav-import job failed to trigger or run in job-scheduler. [ev_6, ev_15]
- **2026-09-23 02:00 IST (2026-09-22T20:30:00Z)** market-data-service nav_age_s was already elevated at 95,040 seconds (~26.4 hours), serving 2026-09-21 NAVs. [ev_4, ev_16]
- **2026-09-23 08:55 IST (2026-09-23T03:25:00Z)** CHG-48221 applied to cache service, extending nav TTL from 1h to 6h. [ev_3, ev_7]
- **2026-09-23 09:30 IST (2026-09-23T04:00:00Z)** Users began reporting unchanged mutual fund portfolio valuations; portfolio-service logged repeated warnings of NAVs older than one trading day. [ev_14]

## Confidence
0.85: High confidence based on unambiguous metrics showing market-data-service nav_age_s monotonically increasing over 35 hours, logs confirming served NAVs dated 2026-09-21, and the total absence of nav-import executions in job-scheduler.

## Gaps
- Job-scheduler logs and schedule definitions prior to 2026-09-22T20:30:00Z were not inspected due to tool call budget limits. (impact: The exact mechanism by which nav-import failed to trigger at 23:30 IST (crontab misconfiguration, unscheduled job, or scheduler daemon restart) cannot be pinpointed.)

## Recommended actions (not executed)
- **[now]** Manually trigger the nav-import job to pull the latest NAV feed from AMFI into market-data-service. [ev_4, ev_16]
  - Why: Directly refreshes the stale mutual fund NAV dataset from 2026-09-21 to the latest available AMFI data.
  - Verify: Check market-data-service metric nav_age_s to confirm it drops to near zero, and verify log outputs show successful ingestion of 2026-09-22 NAVs.
- **[now]** Flush the nav keyspace in cache and verify portfolio-service valuation updates. [ev_3, ev_14]
  - Why: Ensures any stale 2026-09-21 NAVs cached under the 6-hour TTL configured in CHG-48221 are evicted immediately.
  - Verify: Query portfolio-service logs to confirm cessation of 'fund NAV older than 1 trading day' warnings.
- **[next]** Investigate job-scheduler crontab and scheduler definitions for nav-import, and add alerting for nav_age_s > 86400s. [ev_4, ev_15]
  - Why: Prevents future silent failures of overnight NAV ingestion from going unnoticed until user reports arrive the next morning.
  - Verify: Confirm job-scheduler cron entry is registered and verify alert fires when synthetic NAV age exceeds threshold.

## Justification
The root cause is definitively established by telemetry: market-data-service nav_age_s had already climbed past 26.4 hours at 2026-09-22T20:30Z (predating the morning cache config change), job-scheduler logs confirmed nav-import never executed during the window, market-data-service served 2026-09-21 NAVs, and portfolio-service logged explicit fallback warnings for NAVs older than one trading day.
